tuner.title: Guitar Tuner
tuner.subtitle: Tune your guitar with the microphone or by ear, with the right sound for each string.
tuner.idle_hint: Turn the microphone on and play one string at a time.
tuner.too_low: Too low: tighten the tuning peg slowly.
tuner.too_high: Too high: loosen the tuning peg a little.
tuner.mic_denied: We couldn't use your microphone. Allow access in your browser settings or use the reference sounds below.
tuner.mic_unsupported: Your browser doesn't support microphone access. Use the reference sounds below.
tuner.reference_hint: Play each string and compare it with your guitar.
tuner.how_title: How to tune without getting lost
tuner.tip_1: Tuning pegs sit at the end of the neck. Tightening raises the pitch; loosening lowers it.
tuner.tip_2: Play only one string at a time and let it ring. Several strings at once confuse the tuner.
tuner.tip_3: Turn the peg very slowly, a little at a time, then play the string again to check.
tuner.tip_4: Find a quiet spot and start from the thickest string (6th) to the thinnest (1st).
